Explore un labyrinthe dans le noir à la: Explore a maze in the dark by the light of a lantern: find the key, hidden furthest from the start, then the door, furthest from the key. What the lantern has lit stays on the map. Generated mazes that are always solvable, bigger at each level, a fixed or random layout per level, and a time record per level.
